batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b CH Morris

batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c LS Livingstone b GD Phillips

batting.name: LS Livingstone
batting.dismissal: c RA Tripathi b LH Ferguson

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b Shivam Mavi

batting.name: JD Unadkat
batting.dismissal: c Shakib Al Hasan b LH Ferguson

batting.name: C Sakariya
batting.dismissal: run out (KD Karthik, Shakib Al Hasan)

balls.text: yorker on leg, as Morgan is off balance while trying to dig that out. It takes his pad - and so Morris appeals for leg before which the umpire doesn't give - and the batters take a leg-bye
whips that to deep square leg to finish off with a six! Uses his bottom hand to bam that full ball on off after standing on nearly off stump. Typical Morgan whack

swing and a miss, but that is still a gift for Knight Riders as Samson fails to collect that. Slower ball from Morris on a full length on off, and angling away. The ball just drops ahead of him, and takes off from his glove
heaved away to find deep square leg again off this full ball on off

Morgan goes across off, as Morris bowls that full and outside leg. Morgan goes for the flick, but misses to steal a bye. Morris then throws at the bowler's end after getting the ball from Samson, but misses
whips that full ball on middle to deep square leg
starts with a slower ball on a fullish length and wide of off. Morgan slashes at that without foot movement, as the ball goes to Samson, who can't collect it cleanly to allow a bye
yorker length on middle - which ends as a low full-toss - as Morgan clips to fine leg
squeezed between point and short third man! Change of pace, and very full and wide of off. Morgan reaches for it, and drills that in the gap for four
goes for the hoick to this full ball outside off, but gets that off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket. The 150 is up for Knight Riders
looks to scoop this over the keeper, but the ball is too full and outside off for him to get a bat
good length and outside off - and with good bounce too - as Morgan dabs that to point
this shoots low and below Morgan's bat! Fullish length and outside off with a change of pace, as Morgan stands across off to try and tap at that, but the ball sneaks below
and another slower ball. Karthik goes for the slash to this full ball outside off, but is beaten
slower ball, and full and wide of off. Morgan reaches out for it, and slashes it right to the man at extra cover
full delivery on middle and leg, and clipped to fine leg

change of pace again, and he strikes Morgan on the back pad. Half an appeal for leg before, but not given. And Samson reviews. Sakariya bowls full and outside off, with the ball angling in. No inside edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. Pitching outside off, and the impact would have outside off too. So Royals lose their review
full ball on off, and pushed back to the left of the bowler. Karthik wants a run, but is sent back after the ball trickles off Sakariya's left hand

bowled him! Castles him with that change of pace. Sakariya bowls on a good length on middle, as Tripathi looks to swing that away to the on side after going down on his back knee and making a touch of room. But he is beaten by the lack of pace, and the ball strikes the middle pole

much fuller on middle, and that takes his pads. Karthik is off for a run, as Fizz runs forward to hit the stumps at the keeper's end while Karthik dives back in. The square leg umpire goes upstairs, and replays show Karthik was well in
wham! That is out of the ground! Karthik uses the shorter boundary to full effect, as Fizz offers him the short ball just outside off, and he pulls that from deep in his crease
short of a length on middle at 138kph. The ball skids on, as he pulls to deep midwicket
chops that on the bounce to the keeper. Fullish ball on middle, and he plays at that from really close to his body, which is why couldn't get it away
fuller on off, and he presents the full face of the bat to push that to long-on
back of a length on off, and clipped to deep square leg. A rapid second is stolen, as the bowler gives the chase to his right
good length ball on off, and clipped toward long-on with the closed face of the bat
short of a length, and a touch wide of off. Cuts that to point, where a fumble allows a quick single

leading edge, and taken at cover! Morris has his first wicket in the UAE in this leg. The ball was too full on off to try and heave that across to the on side, as Gill played from deep in his crease and his front leg near the leg stump. The ball went sailing, as Jaiswal took a few steps to his left to take that
fuller delivery on middle and leg, and angling down further. Wide called, as Samson collects that to his left

whacks it to deep midwicket on the bounce! Phillips dives to his right - in fact almost flies - but the ball lands wide of him and just short of the rope. That was a slower ball on a good length on off, and Gill waited for it before slamming that powerfully
drills that right back to the stumps at the other end! That was very full and just outside off, and the bails light up in a flash
skiddy length and fullish on middle and leg. Pushed to long-on after a touch of room
slams that good length ball wide of off back to the bowler from the toe end of the bat while playing away from his body. He threatens Tripathi with a throw, but the batter is in

bottom edge, and four behind the wicket! That is Gill's fifty too. Again he comes down the track early, as Sakariya bowls this pretty full and just outside off. Gill looks to heave, but gets a bottom edge past the off stump
slower ball on a full length outside off, and he skips down to open the bat face and dab that late to short third man
clips this full ball on off to deep square leg by playing across the line
good length ball on middle and leg, and turned behind to short fine leg. A quick single is stolen
dances down after making room to this short ball outside off and slashes that on the bounce to deep point
good length ball angling into him. Checks a pull behind square. Rawat in the deep has to put in the hard yards to intercept. Time out.
full and wide outside off stump. Square drive races through for four! Tewatia is standing at deep point, but the ball glides along the carpet to beat the outfielder

tries to bowl the cutter. Full outside off with pace taken off. Tripathi waits for the ball to get to him before hammering a four down the ground. A bit of a slog but kept the direction straight. Safe, very safe...
thumped past Dube! Slower ball outside off, but ends up as a low full toss. Clattered down the ground to long off
good length on off. Punches down the ground to long on for one. Has to be careful with his feet movement with Samson standing up
length ball just outside off. Checked punch to mid on for a single

dropped by Samson! That one just carried to him, and was wide to his right, as he stretched out hos right glove in front, and the ball popped out of his glove after Tripathi went after a full delivery outside off bowled at a change of pace, and got an outside edge as he opened the face of the bat
good length outside off. Pulled along the ground to midwicket
good length outside off. Comes down the wicket to cut square. Misses
back of a length cutter that angles across Gill. But he stays on the back foot, spots the pace, and then drags a sloggy shot off the back foot to deep midwicket for four!
full on off from around the stumps. Mistimed drive to deep extra cover

full on his pads around leg stump. Flicked gently, and more importantly through the gap behind square on the leg side. Dube runs to the boundary line and gets down late to parry the ball back into play! Dube may have hurt a finger, but the replay says he's done a great job!
full outside leg. Tripathi gets forward and flicks through the deep midwicket gap! 17 off the over
good length outside leg stump. Skidding through with Tripathi missing the flick

holes out! So Rana falls after a 5-ball 12. Which isn't too shabby, but KKR would've wanted a bigger cameo. Full outside off. Rana tries to loft it over extra cover but he's toe-ended the shot. Long off gobbles it up
swatted away! Tosses it up on off stump. Rana moves to the leg side, and makes room to go through with the full swing of the bat. Thumped over the umpire's head
continues around the stumps. Full on leg, and he drills it down to long on where Livingstone is standing
fullish on off stump. Punched to deep extra cover for a single
around the stumps. Full and wide, and Rana approaches the over with aggression. Drives, and drives with the angled bat. Pierces the gap behind point!
full on his toes at leg stump. Driven to long on for one

Iyer will be so disappointed as he gets bowled trying to play the reverse sweep. Iyer changed his stance to play the reverse. Tewatia bowls stump to stump. He misses the shot, and it hits the pad before crashing into his stump. Partnership broken after 79
flat ball. Full and wide. Cut in front of square to the fielder manning the boundary line on the off side
full outside off. Angling further away. Iyer cuts to deep backward point for a single
full on middle. Goes onto the back foot to nudge it leg side
full, very wide, and turning away. Free run

one-handed six! Full outside off. Turning away. Gill skips down the ground and tries to hit it over deep midwicket but was beaten in the air so isn't to the pitch of the ball. Gets enough to clear wide long on
another wide yorker outside off. Inside the tramlines once again. Pinpoint stuff from Unadkat, and his work is done for the evening with the ball
wide yorker, outside off. Inside the tramlines, so perfectly legal
pure power! He's a big guy, and he makes full use of his build. Good length outside off. Stands tall and punches it with disdain over the umpire's head
length ball. Walks down the ground and thumps to deep midwicket
full on his pads and flicked to deep square leg for one

second six of the evening for KKR! Slower ball to start off. Full, just outside off, and he picks the length early before swatting it over deep midwicket. Bit of a doubt if it would clear the boundary, but it just about does. 72m six
around the stumps. Full toss on off, but Iyer can't maximise. Slapped to deep extra cover for one
full and wide outside off. Rolls his fingers over the ball again. Slogs to deep midwicket for one
play and a miss. Full and wide outside off. Gill plants his front foot and tries to slog through the leg side. Misses out altogether
back of a length slower ball outside off. Iyer skips down the ground and mistimes a pull to deep midwicket
full just outside off. Muscles a shot to long on. Has to stay in the crease with Samson standing up
full outside off from around the stumps. Flicked to deep backward square leg for one
trapped lbw? Not given! Slower ball, cutter angling in. Tries to slog this length ball over the deep on the leg side. Misses and hits the front leg. Impact outside off stump perhaps
slower ball. Length ball outside off and angling in. Tries to nudge it leg side, but leading edge takes it to cover
short and wide. In Iyer's range for him to slap a cut, but he misses. Through to the keeper as umpire Gough says wide
full and wide outside off. Cuts to deep point for one

just over the keeper! Short ball outside off and Iyer is in a tangle. Fizz saw the batter coming down the track and went short. Iyer has to adjust late, and the paddle hits the shoulder of his bat before going over Samson
full ball angling into him, and flicked to short fine leg for a single
good length outside off. Chops a shot down to short third man
back of a length over the stumps again. Just outside off. Pulls along the ground to deep backward square leg. Time out
tickled well! Good length outside off. Stays on the back foot, lets the ball to come to him, and then guides it past short third man! Not an easy shot
slower ball. Goes full and wide. Gill waits and then slaps a shot through the off side to deep extra cover
cutter. Full on off and nudged off his pads to square leg for one
full outside off. Mistimed drive to long on for a single
around the stumps. Cramping him with a length ball that cramps in. Mistimed swipe to deep midwicket
play and a miss. Good length outside leg. He comes down the track to swing a shot to the leg side. Misses, and it goes just over leg stump!
full on off, and he places the on-drive to long on for a single
full on leg stump. Comes down the ground and shovels a toe-ended drive to cover's left. They get a single
full on leg stump. Tapped to cover, but no chance of a run
full on leg and the inside out drive to mid off. Stopped by the fielder
drills a shot to mid off for a single
fullish outside off and he muscles a drive through the off side. Morris at mid off runs to his right and then dives, but can't get a hand to it!
good length on his pads, and flicked to deep backward square leg
full ball outside off. Guided to short third man, and Rawat throws to the keeper. Is Gill run out? No, he went out but came back in time
full outside off, and a gentle fronf-foot drive. Stopped at cover
keeper standing up so that Gill doesn't dance down the wicket. Sakariya with a length ball angling across. Late cut to short third man
uses his feet! Fullish on off. Comes down the ground to convert it into a slot ball. Thumps it over Sakariya's head for a six over long on
good length outside off, and he flays a punch. Can that beat cover? No! Jaiswal with the dive
full on off. Comes down the ground, gets to the leg side of the ball, and smacks a drive to cover. One ball to go
good length outside off. Punched down the ground, past Unadkat, for a quick single
slower ball. Full on leg, and going down the leg side. Iyer tried to flick it fine but missed out
full on his toes, and the flick finds Sakariya once again at midwicket. Iyer will be disappointed not putting that through the gap
full on off and angling in. The drive finds midwicket on the circle
good length ball outside off. Comes down the ground to hoick a shot over the leg side. But inside-edged onto his pads
good length outside off but angling in. Tries to punch with the full face of the bat but inside edged to deep square leg instead
good length ball outside off. Stands tall to cut but the bat's face turns in his hand. Mistimed to point
fullish, on off stump. Tap and run to the off side for a single
bottom-edged to Samson on the bounce. Length ball angling across, and the cut does not go where intended
full outside off. Crunches a drive to mid off, and intercepted
mid-on stretches out his hand, but the ball just beats him! Iyer heaves across the line to this full ball on middle and leg, and gets four despite that coming off the inside half of the bat
full and very wide of off. Gill dances down and has a flick, but is beaten. The ball drops out of Samson's gloves as he dives to his left, and that allows an extra run
gets a bottom edge as he looks to slash at that short and wide ball outside off
gets an inside edge as he drives at this full delivery a touch wide of off without any foot movement. The ball trickles to the off side, and he manages a single
has a flash, but is beaten! This is a touch shorter and wide of off, as he swings away from his body and misses
good diving stop by cover-point to his right! Phillips the man there. Iyer drives this full delivery just outside off by opening the bat face, but can't find the gap
good length ball on middle, and clipped to the man at midwicket
full delivery on middle, and angling in. Clipped to midwicket to get off the mark
stands on leg stump, and taps this full delivery on off toward cover
good length ball outside off and in the channel, and he has Gill poking and missing again
drives that aerially to beat mid-off! The man there dives to his right, but can't get a hand, as Gill again presents the full face of the bat to this full delivery on off, and bags four
good length ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket after a step down the wicket
beats him first ball! Pitches it pretty full and just outside off, as the ball passes Gill's bat, which he presents with the full face

bottom edge on to the stumps, and gone! This is the lowest total by Royals this IPL. Tewatia goes for the slash to this full ball wide of off, and gets it off the bottom edge and on the bounce to the stumps. Mavi bowls one with a change of pace, and finishes with his best IPL figures
full and a bit wide of off. He lets that go
full ball, and a touch wide of off. Beats his bat which is dangling out, although he withdraws it late
good length ball on off turning into him, and blocked back

Sakariya is run-out at the keeper's end! The throw was very accurate and very close to the stumps, where Karthik's gloves took off the bails hurriedly. There was a mix-up among the batters after Tewatia went for the slog-sweep to this full ball on middle, but got a top edge toward fine leg. Sakariya thought there was two - and even Tewatia took a step forward for it - but was sent back and eventually fell short
very full and straight on middle. Defended back
tosses it up to go full outside off, and has the ball turning into the batter, who misses the drive, as the sneaks through for a bye

slashed over point! Gill runs and dives to his left from third man, and saves a few has his back boot touching the rope while trying to pat that ball back. It was a good length ball wide of off, and Tewatia looked to utilise the width available
pulls this short of a length ball outside off, and bisects long-on and deep square leg for a couple more
lifts that between mid-off running back and long-on running to his right! It is a full ball in the slot on off, and he goes for the uppish drive again. But the ball somehow lands safely
fuller ball on off, and defended back to the bowler
dances around in his crease to first move his back leg and finally going across to try and scoop that fullish ball on middle and leg, but misses, as the ball goes over the stumps
goes full and just outside off at 147.5kph, as Tewatia drags it to mid-off
tosses it up to go very full on off. Defended back to the right of the bowler
shorter in length on middle and leg, and clipped toward long-on. Varun gives the chase for a second, but gives it up after that
very full on middle and leg, and he defends off the outside edge, with the ball rolling over toward point
full and quicker on off. Blocked back toward extra cover
slower and full on off. Taps this toward point
goes for the reverse-sweep to this full ball outside off, but finds wide-ish third man
sticks his front leg out to this good length ball wide of off, which is turning into him
full and straighter on off. Blocked back off the front foot
comes down the track to this full and wide ball outside off. He reaches out for it to lob that over the bowler's head for a single
very full ball on middle, and digs it out to drive to long-on. A single refused again
tonks that high and bang on one of the advertising boards beyond deep square leg! Bowls fullish on middle, and Tewatia sweeps powerfully after going down on his back knee
fullish ball outside leg, and turning down further. Clipped to fine leg
looks to jab at that good length ball just outside off, but misses! He roars out his frustration after that too.
slower ball, and short and wide of off. Tewatia waits for it come before slapping it through extra cover for four! Forceful punch, and four runs
good length ball again on middle, and clipped to deep square leg. Doesn't take a single again
good length ball just outside off, and he opens the bat face to run that down to third man. No run taken
goes slogging, and finds deep point! Fullish ball on off, as he looks to slice that over the off side, but the ball takes off from the bottom of the bat to go ballooning to Shakib in the deep
lifted over extra cover! Goes inside out to this good length ball on middle by backing away and just lofting his arms
slashed to cover now. This is shortish and wide of off, and he reaches out to play at that
this one turns into him off a good length outside off, and he cuts that to deep point
drills a drive off this very full on off, but finds Morgan at cover
a touch shorter on off, and clipped to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
slogged over deep square leg! Swings his arms to sweep this full ball on middle after going down on his back knee, and bang!
good length ball on middle, and lapped away to fine leg
another full ball and outside off. Punched to deep point, where the man sprints to his left to cut that off
clips that to fine leg, where Narine lets that pass below his left hand. Full delivery on middle and leg, and just tickled behind for four
fuller ball on off, and clipped to the man at midwicket
cut away to just beat point! The fielder dives to his left, but doesn't get any contact, as Tewatia slaps this short delivery outside off with some width
full and wide of off, and crunched to deep extra cover. The man at cover dives to his right, but doesn't get a hand. Firmly driven with a good stretch out
fullish ball on off, and punched to the man at cover

the finger goes up even before Varun has finished appealing, and Royals lose their seventh! That was too full on middle to try and sweep after going down on his back knee, repeating the shot from previous ball. Knight Riders riding on well here
strikes him on his front pad, as he looks to sweep this full ball outside off. Half an appeal for leg before, but not give since the impact was always outside off
very full on off, and drilled to long-off
turns away from him! Full delivery on off, and spins further away as he jabs at that
short and wide of off, slashed to the man at cover
full ball on off, and blocked back off the front foot
stumps knocked back again! Ball stays a bit low too. Fullish on middle and leg. Dube is slow to get low and flick. Misses the shot. Hits the front leg, and then crashes into the wickets.
full on middle, and flicked to deep midwicket for a single
good length on middle. Fended back to Mavi off the back foot

top of off! Fullish ball on off. Phillips tries to stay on the back foot to punch straight. The ball zips through instead of jagging in. Past the outside edge, and the zing bails have been lit. Time out.
full outside off. Drives away from his body, and gets the ball through to the sweeper-fielder at deep extra cover
full on leg stump. Looks to drill a flick through midwicket but ends up inside-edging onto his pad
good length on middle. Turning into leg. Looks to flick, but misses. Hits the body
tossed up on off. Phillips just leans into a golf-swing type six over Narine's head!
over the stumps. Length ball outside off and turning away. Cuts off the back foot to cover point
good length, wider outside off. Turning in, and flat-batted to long on. Gill misfields, but recovers
drops the length this time. Turning in from off. Worked to midwicket
welcomed with a six! Full outside off from around the stumps. Big stride into the shot, and thumped over long on
full outside off. Throws the bat at it, and drives it to the right of mid off. Rajasthan 17/4 after the powerplay
back of a length outside off. Extra bounce as he looks to play a square punch. Whizzes past the outside edge
good length outside off. Caresses a punched shot to the off side again. Shakib into the action again
over the stumps. Length ball, a bit wider outside off. Punched to cover off the back foot. Shakib is at point
good length outside off, and punched with the bat's open face to deep point for one
back of a length outside off and angling into his pads. Inside edges a defensive shot onto his body
good length on off. Skidding in from over the stumps. Punched to midwicket's left, and intercepted
full on off, and worked off his pads to midwicket
good length outside off. Looks to punch off the back foot, but it takes the outside edge. Rolls away to third man
full outside off stump. Cut to point for a single
full on off stump, and defended back off the front foot
around the stumps. Full just outside off. Bit of turn inwards. Defended to the leg side
inswinger from outside off stump. Inside edge onto his pads as he looks to defend
good length outside off. Rides the bounce, shuffes across to the off side, and fends it back

trapped lbw? Of course! Full on off and angling in from around off stump. Tries to flick it leg side but doesn't connect. Finger raised and Rawat reviews, but this looks plumb. The left-hander has to go back for a first-ball duck. Ball-tracking is a mere formality: this is crashing into middle stump.
good length ball angling in from around stumps. Stands tall and nudges it off the back foot to fine leg. Varun runs around to intercept

up high! And taken by Tripathi! Short ball, rising delivery. Swivels to pull but too late into the shot. Sliced in the air, and its coming down swiftly, but the fielder runs in from deep backward square leg to take a tumble and catch. 12/3
full pace from first ball. Length ball outside off, zipping straight through on the corridor of uncertainty. Livingstone tries to poke at it but can't get any bat on ball
around the stumps. Full on off and angling into him. Looks to nudge it leg side but it hits the pad and rolls away to the leg side
good length, on off stump. Nudged off his pads to midwicket
full on off, and nudged to mid on's right for a quick single
good length ball just outside off. Plays the cut to cover point and is slow to get off the blocks. Mavi runs around, intercepts, has a shy at the stumps! Very nearly run out at the bowler's end
good length outside off. Shuffles onto the back foot fast and cut to deep backward point for four! Gets the gap
good length, on off, and flicked to midwicket for a single
full on middle. Comes down the ground to hoick a shot over the leg side. But he misses, and it hits the front leg. But not out since impact is definitely outside off stump
full outside leg. Tries to flick, but no bat involved. Hits the pad
good length, on leg stump. Punched to mid off, off the back foot
crunches a drive through cover point! But Tripathi gives the ball a chase, and slides along the grass to intercept near the boundary line
strikes first ball! And its the wicket of the skipper! Good length ball angling in, and his gentle flick goes straight to Morgan diving to his right at midwicket!
full on middle. And pushed to long on for a single
good length, on off. Rocks back and punches to cover
full outside off from around the stumps. Defended off the front foot to cover
bowled him around his legs! Goes for the reverse sweep, Shakib goes full on off. Misses the shot, ball stays low, and his offstump is rattled. Armball does the trick
full just outside off. Turning in. Nudged to midwicket's right
first ball over the stumps. Full outside off. Jaiswal tries to slog leg side but the ball whizzes past the outside edge!
